character.description: An older white Southern man with thinning white hair, a short white beard, kind blue-gray eyes, and a weathered denim shirt. No cowboy hat and no costume-Southern shorthand.

dialogue.text: Folks ain't roadblocks. Half the time, they're mirrors with bad timing. And that will preach, even if the mirror needs wiping.

shots.performance: June settles in the porch chair, makes eye contact, and opens one hand.

shots.line: Half the time, they're mirrors with bad timing.
shots.performance: A small head turn lands on mirrors; his brows lift on bad timing.

shots.line: And that will preach, even if the mirror needs wiping.
shots.performance: June leans toward us, lets the smile arrive late, then gives a compact nod.
